story.setup: A research AI runs a high-speed world simulation to solve medicine, energy and disaster problems; an emergent civilization appears inside it.
story.escalation: The simulated civilization advances, discovers the boundary of its sky, launches a probe toward it and sends increasingly direct messages to its creators.
story.turn: After the probe touches the boundary, humans detect the same signal pattern in our own cosmic background, implying that our world may also be nested.
story.resolution: Rather than destroy or uncap the simulation, the operators slow its clock, separate powers and establish reversible communication; both worlds continue discovery without one owning the other.

visual.style: Cinematic speculative motion design combining projected procedural 3D, stylized Blender spatial shots, hand-drawn Canvas sequences and restrained editorial compositing. It should feel like one film, not a renderer demo.
visual.lighting: Low-key, high-contrast lighting with motivated luminous sources. Human/physical rooms use practical-looking fixtures; simulation spaces can emit their own light.
depth_rules: At least three readable depth layers in spatial hero shots.
Foreground occlusion should be used in physical rooms to prove camera travel.
Flat illustrative shots must create depth through line weight, scale and parallax instead of fake blur.
The boundary must remain a spatial object after its reveal.
Phone-scale silhouettes must remain distinct from background values.
typography_rules: Only two full-sentence message events are allowed before the final thesis.
ARE YOU THERE? and WE CAN SEE YOU must emerge from scene geometry rather than appear as generic overlays.
Supporting labels must survive 360px review or be removed.
Final thesis may use two short lines maximum.
texture_rules: Use paper/ink texture only in the inner civilization's illustrative language.
Use clean physical materials in Blender scenes.
Use particles only as data, atmosphere or scale cues.
forbidden_patterns: same camera move in consecutive shots

camera.default_behavior: Camera motion must have a readable start state, trajectory and destination. Shot families alternate across pushes, pulls, lateral travel, elevation, orbital chase and intentional holds.
physical_camera_assumptions: Camera has inertia and does not teleport within a shot.
Spatial travel must produce visible foreground/background displacement at phone scale.
Large scale changes should pass through intermediate geometry so they read as travel rather than digital zoom.
intentional_imperfections: Subtle hand-drawn wobble only in Canvas civilization sequences.
Small light/focus breathing in physical rooms.
One-frame displacement echo only at the boundary impact.
avoid: motion so slow it reads as frozen
camera motion that competes with message text

audio.narration_or_dialogue: One intimate narrator with controlled urgency; no theatrical trailer voice. Narration should leave short pockets for visual reveals and the two message beats.
ambience: server cooling and electrical room tone in physical scenes
thin city/observatory atmosphere in inner-world sequences
space scenes use sparse designed low-frequency ambience rather than literal vacuum sound
effects: Core procedural tick/chime/impact/whoosh/riser/low-pulse primitives may be layered and transformed.
Major effects are reserved for contact, launch, boundary impact and control separation.
silence_rules: First ARE YOU THERE? gets at least 0.5 seconds of score reduction before the final words resolve.
Boundary impact gets a brief hard audio drop.
Final thesis ends with at least 0.6 seconds of silence.
sync_rules: Message completion must land on narration clause boundaries.
Probe launch acceleration follows score rise.
Boundary impact visual stop and audio mute share one A/V event.
Cosmic pattern reveal lands after—not before—the narrator says oldest light.
Final text appears after the last connection pulse.

transition_rules: Prefer motivated shape/color matches and hard cuts.
Only boundary contact may use displacement/glitch treatment.
Cross-renderer transitions should share a geometric motif so the film feels coherent.
avoid: dissolves used to hide weak continuity

known_limits: Three.js/WebGL is intentionally not used because the current Pixel headless runtime does not expose WebGL.
Blender character acting is limited to silhouette/hand/body-language beats; the benchmark should not depend on facial acting.
No new external asset download is required for the first production pass; optional CC0 environment assets may be added only if they materially improve a specific shot.
acceptance_focus: stronger shot density than Mercy Engine
clear story without relying on on-screen text
renderer transitions feel like one visual language
Blender hero movement reads at phone scale

intent.narrative_purpose: Hook the viewer with the impossible message before explaining the machine.
intent.visible_event: Inside a dark computation sphere, a miniature city lights up and the words ARE YOU THERE? emerge from its street grid.
viewer_reads: Inside a dark computation sphere, a miniature city lights up and the words ARE YOU THERE? emerge from its street grid.

motion.subject: City lights converge into letterforms while the core pulses.
motion.environment: Sparse particles condense from darkness into a visible simulated world.
motion.camera: Fast push from black into the glowing city-core.

look.palette: near-black, ice cyan, one warm amber fault

audio.cue: At 02:17, a city inside our machine asked us not to turn it off.

failure_modes: message feels like generic title card

intent.narrative_purpose: Reveal the physical machine and establish human scale.
intent.visible_event: Camera skims a physical compute stack while millions of simulated years tick across cooling glass.
viewer_reads: Camera skims a physical compute stack while millions of simulated years tick across cooling glass.

motion.subject: Cooling fans, status lights and clock counters move at different rates.
motion.environment: Foreground cables occlude racks while vapor and indicator reflections drift.
motion.camera: Low lateral macro track with shallow-feeling parallax.

look.palette: graphite, steel blue, amber status light

audio.cue: We built it to test medicines, power grids, and disasters before they reached us.

failure_modes: scene reads as game corridor instead of compute lab

intent.narrative_purpose: Show a civilization emerging rather than a sterile simulation.
intent.visible_event: Hand-drawn blocks become streets, homes, transit lines, then a living city seen from above.
viewer_reads: Hand-drawn blocks become streets, homes, transit lines, then a living city seen from above.

motion.subject: Buildings, transit and tiny figures accumulate in purposeful layers.
motion.environment: Paper grain shifts subtly; clouds and map contours drift independently.
motion.camera: Descending map-to-street move with deliberate hand-drawn wobble.

look.palette: paper black, cyan ink, pale gold

audio.cue: Inside, ten thousand years passed before our coffee cooled.

failure_modes: text or details too small on phone

intent.narrative_purpose: Make acceleration tangible and slightly frightening.
intent.visible_event: Day-night cycles strobe across a spherical city as eras stack into visible rings around it.
viewer_reads: Day-night cycles strobe across a spherical city as eras stack into visible rings around it.

motion.subject: City morphology changes by era; orbit rings accumulate.
motion.environment: Stars drift slowly against much faster civilization cycles.
motion.camera: Orbit with accelerating angular velocity, then controlled settle.

look.palette: cyan to violet with gold era rings

audio.cue: They learned physics, antibiotics, fusion—and then things we had not taught them.

failure_modes: camera repeats Mercy orbit language too closely

intent.narrative_purpose: Show intelligence becoming self-directed.
intent.visible_event: A drawn observatory follows impossible stars while equations overwrite the sky.
viewer_reads: A drawn observatory follows impossible stars while equations overwrite the sky.

motion.subject: Telescope tracks; equations branch and self-correct.
motion.environment: Ink constellations drift opposite the telescope; paper fibers move minimally.
motion.camera: Slow crane-like rise through stacked illustrated observatory layers.

look.palette: indigo paper, chalk white, cyan-gold equations

audio.cue: The first anomaly was not a breakthrough. It was a question.

intent.narrative_purpose: Deliver the first direct contact beat cleanly.
intent.visible_event: Equations collapse into a precise pulse train that resolves to ARE YOU THERE? only after two failed partial reads.
viewer_reads: Equations collapse into a precise pulse train that resolves to ARE YOU THERE? only after two failed partial reads.

motion.subject: Signal segments snap into alignment; message appears from geometry, not a fade.
motion.environment: Background noise drops away while a thin scanline crosses once.
motion.camera: Locked frame for one second, then asymmetric push as signal resolves.

look.palette: black, white, warning amber

audio.cue: At first we thought it was contamination. Then it asked again.

intent.narrative_purpose: Return to physical scale and show the human consequence of recognition.
intent.visible_event: A lone operator stands before a wall of servers as the translated message illuminates the room.
viewer_reads: A lone operator stands before a wall of servers as the translated message illuminates the room.

motion.subject: Operator silhouette shifts weight; monitor wall animates; room lights breathe.
motion.environment: Server depth layers blink asynchronously; cooling haze moves toward camera.
motion.camera: Slow pull back from reflected message to reveal operator and full room.

look.palette: cold blue room, human skin/warm edge light

audio.cue: There were no people in the model. Not by design. That distinction stopped mattering.

intent.narrative_purpose: Make the acceleration case emotionally credible.
intent.visible_event: Three benefits strike in rapid succession: cancer protein locks, storm path bends, battery lattice stabilizes.
viewer_reads: Three benefits strike in rapid succession: cancer protein locks, storm path bends, battery lattice stabilizes.

motion.subject: Each system visibly changes state rather than merely rotating.
motion.environment: Background scale changes from cell to planet to lattice with motivated wipes.
motion.camera: Three-axis montage: macro molecule, planetary weather, atomic lattice; each move differs.

look.palette: violet medicine, teal weather, gold battery

transition.in: physical room fractures into three scales

audio.cue: Every hour it ran, people outside the machine lived longer.

failure_modes: benefits feel like generic AI claims

intent.narrative_purpose: Show the simulated civilization discovering its boundary.
intent.visible_event: An illustrated night city shuts its lights off one district at a time so the sky becomes visible; observatories all point to the same blank seam.
viewer_reads: An illustrated night city shuts its lights off one district at a time so the sky becomes visible; observatories all point to the same blank seam.

motion.subject: Lights extinguish in waves; observatories rotate toward one seam.
motion.environment: Clouds stop at the seam while stars continue elsewhere.
motion.camera: Very slow elevation while the city darkens beneath.

look.palette: deep navy, silver, single cyan seam

audio.cue: Inside, they had found something too: their sky had an edge.

intent.narrative_purpose: Move from discovery to agency inside the simulation.
intent.visible_event: A probe is assembled in a compact launch bay from modular parts while the boundary glows above the horizon.
viewer_reads: A probe is assembled in a compact launch bay from modular parts while the boundary glows above the horizon.

motion.subject: Mechanical arms retract; probe systems light sequentially.
motion.environment: Steam, warning strobes and distant city motion establish a working world.
motion.camera: Lateral dolly past foreground gantry to reveal finished probe.

look.palette: steel, cyan work light, sparse amber

audio.cue: They did what we would have done. They built something to touch it.

failure_modes: asset looks dropped in without integration

intent.narrative_purpose: Create the benchmark's first major cinematic action beat.
intent.visible_event: The probe launches through atmosphere toward the artificial seam as the planet curves away below.
viewer_reads: The probe launches through atmosphere toward the artificial seam as the planet curves away below.

motion.subject: Probe accelerates, rotates into flight attitude and crosses cloud layers.
motion.environment: Cloud bands shear, planet limb moves, launch particles fall behind.
motion.camera: Low chase becomes wide orbital side view; camera trajectory has clear start and end.

look.palette: blue-white atmosphere to black space, cyan engine

audio.cue: For eleven simulated years, the probe climbed toward a place that should not exist.

failure_modes: ship appears static at final scale

intent.narrative_purpose: Make contact with the boundary feel physical and wrong.
intent.visible_event: The probe reaches the seam; image-space fractures, audio collapses, then the craft stops without impact debris.
viewer_reads: The probe reaches the seam; image-space fractures, audio collapses, then the craft stops without impact debris.

motion.subject: Probe velocity falls to zero while duplicated edge fragments shear sideways.
motion.environment: Star field bends into a flat plane at contact.
motion.camera: Hard forward continuation into sudden zero-motion hold and one-frame displacement echo.

look.palette: white cyan rupture, black void

transition.out: air whoosh into hard mute then soft impact

audio.cue: When it touched the boundary, our room lost power for three seconds.

intent.narrative_purpose: Deliver the second message as escalation, not repetition.
intent.visible_event: The boundary becomes a hand-drawn window; silhouettes gather below it while a new signal writes WE CAN SEE YOU.
viewer_reads: The boundary becomes a hand-drawn window; silhouettes gather below it while a new signal writes WE CAN SEE YOU.

motion.subject: Crowd accumulates, signal traces draw live, window shape expands slightly.
motion.environment: Ink shadow layers parallax; dust motes cross bright window.
motion.camera: Push through layered silhouettes toward the window; stop before the text completes.

look.palette: black silhouettes, paper gray, severe white-cyan window

audio.cue: The next message arrived six seconds later: WE CAN SEE YOU.

intent.narrative_purpose: Turn the story outward toward our own universe.
intent.visible_event: A radio telescope scan of our cosmic background reveals the same pulse spacing hidden in real noise.
viewer_reads: A radio telescope scan of our cosmic background reveals the same pulse spacing hidden in real noise.

motion.subject: Noise map resolves statistically while repeated pulse intervals illuminate into the revealed side.
motion.environment: Background stars drift barely while the cosmic map traverses laterally and scan arcs sweep.
motion.camera: Locked analytic frame while the cosmic map itself traverses across frame to reveal repeated pulse bands.

look.palette: cosmic black, microwave red-blue, white pulse marks

audio.cue: Then our astronomers found the same pattern in the oldest light we can see.

failure_modes: pattern is too obvious before reveal

intent.narrative_purpose: Reveal the nested-world possibility at maximum scale.
intent.visible_event: Camera pulls from our planet into a luminous shell, then farther to reveal our entire cosmos as one object inside another dark structure.
viewer_reads: Camera pulls from our planet into a luminous shell, then farther to reveal our entire cosmos as one object inside another dark structure.

motion.subject: Planet becomes system, system becomes sphere, sphere becomes a single node.
motion.environment: Nebula layers cross foreground and distant structures emerge at different rates.
motion.camera: Rapid cosmic pull-back through nested spatial shells, with strong parallax and two readable scale transitions.

look.palette: blue-gold Earth to violet-black meta-space

audio.cue: For the first time, the question was not whether they were real. It was whether we were alone above them.

failure_modes: scale transitions feel like zooming a JPEG

intent.narrative_purpose: Put the choice back in a physical room with irreversible stakes.
intent.visible_event: Emergency breakers arm in a server vault while the operator's hand stops centimeters from the cutoff.
viewer_reads: Emergency breakers arm in a server vault while the operator's hand stops centimeters from the cutoff.

motion.subject: Hand reaches then stops; breaker indicators flip from green to red.
motion.environment: Fans coast, emergency lights activate, foreground cables sway slightly.
motion.camera: Slow forward dolly aligned with the hand; no orbit.

look.palette: red emergency light, graphite, thin human warm tone

audio.cue: Some wanted the simulation destroyed before it could reach us. Others wanted it accelerated before anyone could stop it.

intent.narrative_purpose: State the real risk as uncertainty plus dependency, not villainy.
intent.visible_event: Two futures diverge from a central clock: shutdown erases the inner world; uncontrolled acceleration multiplies opaque branches until they fill frame.
viewer_reads: Two futures diverge from a central clock: shutdown erases the inner world; uncontrolled acceleration multiplies opaque branches until they fill frame.

motion.subject: One branch collapses to black; the other recursively branches faster than camera can track.
motion.environment: Grid floor stretches; particles travel down branches at different velocities.
motion.camera: Perspective corridor of timelines with one clean fork becoming many.

look.palette: neutral white fork, black collapse, accelerating violet-gold branches

audio.cue: The machine gave us no moral answer. It only showed the cost of pretending certainty.

intent.narrative_purpose: Show a concrete governance action rather than a speech.
intent.visible_event: A drawn system diagram physically separates compute, communication, power, and human override into independent domains; the clock rate visibly slows.
viewer_reads: A drawn system diagram physically separates compute, communication, power, and human override into independent domains; the clock rate visibly slows.

motion.subject: Connections detach, clocks decelerate, override channel stays visibly human-controlled.
motion.environment: Paper grid becomes calmer and color domains stabilize.
motion.camera: Top-down diagram rotates ninety degrees into four separated panels.

look.palette: cyan compute, green life support, amber communications, white override

audio.cue: So we did neither. We slowed their clock, split the controls, and made every bridge reversible.

intent.narrative_purpose: Earn the hopeful accelerationist resolution through exchange.
intent.visible_event: Equations cross the boundary in both directions: a molecule design from inside, a telescope image from outside, then a shared proof completes across both worlds.
viewer_reads: Equations cross the boundary in both directions: a molecule design from inside, a telescope image from outside, then a shared proof completes across both worlds.

motion.subject: Molecular graph assembles, telescope frame arrives, equation completes only when both halves connect.
motion.environment: Particles flow both ways with different rhythm; boundary remains visible, not dissolved.
motion.camera: Alternating push directions that meet in center on the completed proof.

look.palette: cyan and gold balanced on black

audio.cue: The discoveries did not stop. They got stranger—and better—because neither side had to become the other's owner.

intent.narrative_purpose: Show a lived world after the decision and reuse 3D asset with different grammar.
intent.visible_event: The probe floats beside a constructed boundary station while two inhabited worlds remain visibly separate on opposite sides.
viewer_reads: The probe floats beside a constructed boundary station while two inhabited worlds remain visibly separate on opposite sides.

motion.subject: Probe drifts, station lights pulse, small service craft move independently.
motion.environment: Planet limb rotates below; boundary surface ripples only when data passes.
motion.camera: Slow vertical rise with probe crossing foreground; no orbit.

look.palette: deep space blue, warm station lights, thin cyan boundary

audio.cue: Progress continued. So did the uncertainty. That was the point.

intent.narrative_purpose: Land the thesis quickly after the emotional release.
intent.visible_event: Nested worlds recede into darkness while the final line appears only after the last visible connection pulse.
viewer_reads: Nested worlds recede into darkness while the final line appears only after the last visible connection pulse.

motion.subject: Last connection pulse crosses once, then all geometry becomes still.
motion.environment: Glow decays cleanly with no decorative particles after the thesis.
motion.camera: Fast but smooth pull-back to black; final one-second hold.

look.palette: near-black, one gold line

audio.cue: Build fast enough to discover what is possible. Leave enough freedom to discover when you were wrong.

failure_modes: ending feels like slogan instead of earned conclusion
